title: Estimation of a sparse multi-qubit Hamiltonian via compressed sensing
summary: Hamiltonian estimation is an effective approach in studying the structure and dynamical evolution of quantum systems. The difficulty in estimating the Hamiltonian is that an $N$-qubit Hamiltonian has $4^N-1$ unknown parameters, requiring exponentially many equations for information extraction. In this paper we develop a method based on compressed sensing to estimate the Hamiltonian of a multi-qubit system.
